### Data Attributes {#input-data-attributes}

| Attribute                                                                    | Applied when                                                                           | Purpose                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| data-slot="root"                                                             | Always (on `<Input>`)                                                                  | Stable root slot selector for wrapper styling.                        |
| data-slot="label"                                                            | `<Input.Label>` is rendered                                                            | Stable label slot selector with ARIA wiring to the field.             |
| data-slot="asterisk"                                                         | `required` is `true` and `<Input.Asterisk>` is rendered                                | Stable selector for the required-field marker.                        |
| data-slot="container"                                                        | `<Input.Container>` is rendered                                                        | Stable container selector for the field + adornment row.              |
| data-slot="field"                                                            | `<Input.Field>` is rendered                                                            | Stable selector for the native input element.                         |
| data-slot="leading-icon"                                                     | `<Input.LeadingIcon>` is rendered                                                      | Stable selector for the leading inline icon adornment.                |
| data-slot="trailing-icon"                                                    | `<Input.TrailingIcon>` is rendered                                                     | Stable selector for the trailing inline icon adornment.               |
| data-slot="prefix"                                                           | `<Input.Prefix>` is rendered                                                           | Stable selector for the inline prefix adornment.                      |
| data-slot="suffix"                                                           | `<Input.Suffix>` is rendered                                                           | Stable selector for the inline suffix adornment.                      |
| data-slot="clear-button"                                                     | `clearable` is `true`, the field is non-empty, and `<Input.ClearButton>` is rendered   | Stable selector for the clear-button structural owner.                |
| data-slot="spinner"                                                          | `loading` is `true`, the clear button is not active, and `<Input.Spinner>` is rendered | Stable selector for the trailing-side loading indicator.              |
| data-slot="description"                                                      | `<Input.Description>` is rendered and `invalid` is `false`                             | Stable selector for helper text below the field.                      |
| data-slot="error-message"                                                    | `invalid` is `true` and `<Input.ErrorMessage>` is rendered                             | Stable selector for validation feedback announced via `role="alert"`. |
| data-size                                                                    | Always (on root and `<Input.Container>`)                                               | Styling hook for `size`.                                              |
| data-disabled / data-readonly / data-invalid / data-loading / data-clearable | On `<Input.Container>` when the corresponding root prop is enabled                     | Anatomy and state hooks for Input recipes.                            |
